feeds.title: Caracas Chronicles
feeds.description: Caracas Chronicles is an independent news and analysis organization devoted to one of those missions that's easier-said-than-done: making Venezuela make sense.

feeds.title: AULA | Venezuela Politics Blog
feeds.description: This blog talks about political people, democracy, corruption, diplomacy, war, in Venezuela.

feeds.title: Q Costa Rica | Venezuela Website Blog
feeds.description: QCOSTARICA.COM is an independent news media portal by The Q Media featuring news of Venezuela and other wonderful and weird stuff.

feeds.title: ckaleb[dot]com | Venezuela Experience Blogger
feeds.description: I'm Christian Kaleb Caruzo, a Venezuelan comp-sci major, and an aspiring fiction novelist currently living in Caracas, Venezuela—trying to fix that last part. I'll be writing and documenting my past and current experiences in Venezuela, as well my goal of getting my family out of this Socialist Utopia, in addition to other topics such as Video Games.

feeds.title: The Caribbean Camera | Venezuela Newspaper Blog
feeds.description: The Caribbean Camera continues to be a driving force in promoting positive multicultural values across Venezuela and it's constantly growing. It is the only ethnic newspaper that has been a member of the Queen's Park Press Gallery and is often consulted on Venezuela politics.

feeds.title: World Tribune | Venezuela Geopolitics Blog
feeds.description: World Tribune is the only American news outlet that focuses on Venezuelan news and geopolitics. That said, World Tribune champions the competitive spirit of the American Free Press and publishes exclusive reports and commentary on politics and culture as well.

feeds.title: Mommy's Home Cooking
feeds.description: On this site, you can find everyday recipes (most of them egg-free) from a real mom, Venezuelan recipes, anecdotes, some reviews/giveaways, and lots of photos. I'm Oriana, a wife, mom to three wonderful kids, and a passionate baker and cooker of all eggless things delicious. My goal is to give you the confidence and knowledge to cook and bake without eggs while providing quality recipes that your whole family will love.

feeds.title: The Organization for World Peace | Venezuela Peace Blog
feeds.description: The Organization for World Peace (OWP) targets key issues such as war and international security with the aim of educating and challenging individuals as well as larger international institutions to think critically about peaceful solutions to complex issues plaguing society.

feeds.title: Revolución Alimentaria | Venezuela Food Sovereignty Blog
feeds.description: Revolución Alimentaria, a hub of information on food sovereignty developments in the Venezuel and beyond, with an emphasis on regions in the midst of major social transformations.

feeds.title: ENERGY ANALYTICS INSTITUTE (EAI) | Venezuela Educational Blog
feeds.description: EAI provides educational consultancy and training, and delivers professional advice to individuals, companies and organizations interested in the upstream, downstream, and midstream energy sectors of Latin America and the Caribbean with a focus on Venezuela.

feeds.title: The Guardian | Venezuela News Blog
feeds.description: Latest Venezuela news, sports, business, opinion, analysis and reviews from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: Latin America News Dispatch | Venezuela News Blog
feeds.description: The Latin America News Dispatch produces original news stories about Latin America, the Caribbean, U.S. foreign policy, and Hispanics in the United States. Put simply, we dispatch news from the Western hemisphere.

feeds.title: International Liberty | Venezuelan Economic Blog
feeds.description: I am Daniel J. Mitchell, this blog talks about Venezuela's politics, ecomic condition and many other topics.

feeds.title: Giancarlo Fiorella
feeds.description: This blog attempts to bring Venezuelan news and events to an English-speaking audience. Every day, I read through Venezuelan media and translate the day's biggest news into English.

feeds.title: Daniel | Venezuelan Economy Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about exposing the fraud that the Chavez regime represents. It is thus an anti Chavez blog which continues since his death as an anti 'chavismo' blog. This blog aim is simply to narrate how the country is falling to pieces, trying to explain some of the events that took place to account for the demise.

feeds.title: WOLA | Venezuela Human Right Blog
feeds.description: Venezuelan Politics and Human Rights, a blog hosted by the Washington Office on Latin America (WOLA), is a unique resource for journalists, policymakers, scholars, activists and others interested in understanding Venezuelan politics and human rights.

feeds.title: Daily Brief | Venezuela Business Blog
feeds.description: The Venezuelan Daily Brief provides bi-weekly summaries of key news items affecting bulk commodities and the general business environment in Venezuela.

feeds.title: Conspiracy Theories Monitor | Venezuela Politics Blog
feeds.description: Conspiracy theories on political discourse, war, army and many more topics related to Venezuela region.

feeds.title: Forged by Fire | Venezuela Expat Blog
feeds.description: I Ambar write about problems in and with the people of Venezuela. I do write about fashion and other places where I have visited.

feeds.title: On Venezuela
feeds.description: ON VENEZUELA gives news and views on Venezuela from a democratic perspective.

feeds.title: Global Americans » Venezuela
feeds.description: There is a need to broaden analysis and discussion of the Americas within a global context. The newly established non-profit, Global Americans and the website seek to provide that platform and space. Our website will provide a platform not only for our research and analysis, but also for the opinions and analysis of a wide range of scholars and activists.

feeds.title: TODAY | Venezuela News Blog
feeds.description: TODAY is a blog which writes Venezuela news in English.

feeds.title: Mi Terruño | Venezuela Food Blog
feeds.description: I'm Morella the voice, cook, photographer and videographer behind Mi Terruño Food. My blog is all about sharing the flavours I grew up with in Venezuela with easy, vibrant and delicious recipes for everyday life. My blog reflects my philosophy on food, EASY, FRESH, VIBRANT and HEALTHY recipes.

feeds.title: Healing Venezuela
feeds.description: Healing Venezuela is run by volunteers only with no political or religious affiliation. ​Our mission is threefold, we help by:SENDING MEDICAL SUPPLIES TO HOSPITALS AND OTHER NGOS, IMPLEMENTING STRESS MANAGEMENT WORKSHOPS, SPONSORING HIGH SPEC HIV AND CANCER LAB TEST

feeds.title: Comics Forever
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to the review and appreciation of Marvel and DC comics books, art, animation, movies and more.

feeds.title: COMO ID | Venezuela Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: COMO ID is an Interior Design studio with extensive experience in project development and offers a very exclusive selection of textiles for furniture and decoration. We believe that the interior design is a lifestyle that invites people to get to know more about themselves.
